Volunteering organized the way a church: Volunteering organised the way a church runs it. Each ministry has teams and positions; people are qualified for positions and belong to the ministry's pool group; schedules follow the events on the calendar and produce dated occurrences with staffing requirements; coordinators assign people, who accept, decline or propose a substitute; reminders and alerts go out by email. Administrators and users with the Manage Ministries permission see every ministry and may create, deactivate and delete them. A ministry coordinator is given the Manage My Ministries permission instead: the Ministries heading in the sidebar then shows only the ministries they coordinate. A team leader runs their team from the Member Portal. Members use the Member Portal to see their schedule, respond, sign up and offer help.
